melee.description: This Encrusted Anchor was lost at sea long ago and has become harsh and corrosive during its ages of neglect.
This Encrusted Anchor was lost at sea long ago and has become harsh and corrosive during its ages of neglect.
The axe is an effective weapon, favored by the relentless Vindicators of the Arch-Illager's army.
Crafted in the blackest depths of the Fiery Forge and enchanted with fiery powers.
Expertly crafted and a polished weapon of war, the Highland Axe also makes a daring backscratcher.
The preferred blade of thieves and assassins, the Backstabber is a must in any rogue's pack.
A blade for those who know that the surest way to victory is to strike without being seen.
The Battlestaff is a perfectly balanced staff that is ready for any battle.
A staff that grows and shifts as it attacks, the Growing Staff is unpredictable and powerful.
This staff overwhelms its target in battle to explosive effect.
Those who wield a Bone Club prefer a less-subtle approach to problem-solving.
The Bone Cudgel is old enough to be considered an ancient treasure, but still menacing even by modern standards.
The Broken Sawblade has been ravaged by time, but it still does considerable damage.
The Mechanized Sawblade still glows from the fires of the Nether where it was forged.
A massive sword that seems impossibly heavy to lift yet rests easily in a just warrior's hands.
Gifted to one of the Arch-Illager's most distinguished generals upon their conquest of the Squid Coast - this runeblade is infused with dark witchcraft.
Only those with the strength of a champion and the heart of a hero can carry this massive blade.
A lucky blacksmith turned a workshop blunder into a battlefield wonder, fusing two weapons into something new.
The legendary Frost Slayer returns to the battlefield only in the darkest and coldest days of winter.
This blade may look colorless and dead, but it soaks up energy in combat and expels it in a powerful burst.
This blade may look colorless and dead, but it soaks up energy in combat and expels it in a powerful burst.
This curved blade, wielded by the warriors of the Squid Coast, requires a steady hand in battle.
This deadly blade's story was lost to the endless sands of time.
Warriors who view battle as a dance with death prefer double-bladed swords.
The Sparkler lights up the party as it cuts through the darkness.
Daggers are the weapon of cravens - or so folk say.
These lauded twin daggers of the northern mountains are known to freeze their foes to solid ice.
These curved blades shine like the crescent moon on a dark night.
Even the simplest of farmers can wield these Shear Daggers with savage results.
A devastating weapon fit for barbaric fighters.
Whirlwind, forged during an epic windstorm, is a double-bladed axe that levitates slightly.
This cursed, poisonous axe leaves their victims sick for years with just a single scratch.
Gauntlets call back to an ancient style of hand to hand combat.
Soul Fists are gauntlets clad with great gemstones, each containing a powerful soul.
These claw-like weapons, wielded by ancient Illager soldiers, are savage in battle.
Made in the wilds beyond the mountains, these gauntlets have been worn by warriors for centuries.
The glaive, wielded by the servants of the Nameless One, is a weapon with style and power.
Sweep your enemies off their feet with the Cackling Broom.
A relic from ages of darkness; this glaive radiates potent magical energy to ward off the undead.
A toxic cloud seems to follow the Venom Glaive wherever it goes...
Blacksmiths and soldiers alike use the Great Hammer for its strength in forging and in battle.
The Stormlander, enchanted with the power of the raging storm, is a treasure of the Illagers.
A hammer, embedded with a crystal that harnesses the power of gravity, that is incredibly powerful.
A blade fit for expert warriors and fighters, its blade is crafted to inflict precision damage.
The Master's Katana has existed throughout the ages, appearing to heroes at the right moment.
A blade that will not rest until the battle has been won.
The Mace is a brutal tool of war and what it lacks in finesse; it makes up for in power.
This mace, engraved with secret healing runes, grants powerful restorative powers.
This ancient weapon inflicts grave blunt damage to those who cannot evade the deadly metal ball.
This massive blade cleaves even the thickest shulker shells with style and ease.
The Starless Night is haunted by echoes of pain that linger within the pitch-black blade.
The pickaxe has been the iconic tool of adventurers and heroes for as long as anyone can remember.
Diamond is one of the most durable materials, making it an excellent choice for a pickaxe.
The rapier, a nimble and narrow blade, strikes with quick ferocity.
The Bee Stinger, a swift blade inspired by a bee's barb, can draw friendly bees into the fray to fight alongside you.
This needle-like blade is ice cold to the touch and makes quick work of any cut.
A ceremonial weapon that hails from the same region as the Desert Temple.
The twin blades of Nightmare's Bite drip with deadly venom, still potent after all these years.
Strange, distorted laughter seems to whisper from these menacing looking sickles.
Fashioned in the likeness of a familiar foe, this hammer pulls your opponents towards their doom.
A ceremonial knife that uses magical energy to hold the wrath of souls inside its blade.
The warden of Highblock Keep kept this unpleasant blade by their side during interrogations.
A disturbing aura surrounds this knife, as if it has existed for all time and will outlive us all.
A cruel reaper of souls, the Soul Scythe is unsentimental in its work.
Don't ask what unnatural creature's bones were used to build this weapon. You don't want to know.
This scythe belonged to the terror of Highblock Keep, the Jailor.
The Frost Scythe is an indestructible blade that is freezing to the touch and never seems to melt.
The spear, with its long reach and powerful range, is a solid choice of weapon.
The creator of this terrible weapon was said to have an affinity for giant eyes. Thankfully, this weapon was the extent of their madness.
Legend says that this cursed spear is plagued by a soul that controls the mind of any who wield it.
A spear that is watched over by lucky souls, bringing luck to any who wield it.
A sturdy and reliable blade.
The Sinister Sword, drawn to those who face the spookiest of nights, cuts through the night with a howl.
The Diamond Sword is the true mark of a hero and an accomplished adventurer.
The Hawkbrand is the legendary sword of proven warriors.
This knife slices through enemies like the wind that cuts between the mountaintops.
Passed down by nomads who roam the mountain peaks, this knife has been used in countless battles.
Crafted from the never-melting ice atop the mountain peaks, this knife is forever icy to the touch.
These blades are infused with a disturbing purpose after countless ages trapped in the End.
Forged by the survivors of a doomed expedition to the End, these twin blades carry dark secrets.
A whip made of sturdy rope, very dangerous in the right hands.
A sturdy whip made from thick, thorn-laden vines capable of poisoning anything it touches. Be careful not to scratch yourself!

ranged.description: As you wield this unsettling weapon, you might find yourself succumbing to the darkness and becoming one with the night.
A simple but well-rounded piece of weaponry. The hunters of the Pumpkin Pastures say that a bow doesn't let you down, unlike other trinkets.
What indescribable horror! The creeping tentacles of this bow reach for the unknowable Void.
The Bonebow is the pride of Pumpkin Pastures, crafted within the walls of their humble village.
The Twin Bow is the champion of the hero who finds themselves outnumbered and alone.
Let your troubles float away with the Bubble Bow, which seals your target in a bubble on a charged shot.
Entrap your enemies in a strange, syrupy bubble and show them who's boss!
The Bubble Burster creates a chain effect of bubble trouble for your enemies.
A tactical crossbow favored by warriors and hunters alike, the Burst Crossbow is a powerful tool for any hero.
This crossbow, crafted in a forge rich with souls, thrives when an abundance of souls are nearby.
This crossbow has a subtle but corrupting power that is suitable for thieves and nimble warriors alike.
The gears of this ancient Cog Crossbow still turn smoothly, making it a reliable weapon choice to this day.
Found in the farthest reaches of the Nether, the Pride of the Piglins is both vintage and vicious.
The crossbow is the ranged weapon of the Illagers and is a common sight among Pillager warriors.
The peak of mischievous Illager-engineering, the famous Slicer was designed to fire bolts that pierce through even the thickest of armor.
If the color blue had a sound, it would be the shots fired by the Azure Seeker.
Dual Crossbows are the perfect choice for a warrior with quick reflexes in a fast-paced battle.
Enchanted enemies are especially vulnerable to the magic of these crossbows.
While some dismiss the cute Baby Crossbows, these deadly weapons grow into heavy hitters.
The power of TNT fused with the latest in archery design resulted in this devastating crossbow.
The Imploding Crossbow has been magically fine-tuned to maximize the impact of the explosion.
The Firebolt Thrower launches chaos in a chain reaction of exploding arrows.
Why harpoon one enemy when you can harpoon many!
Why harpoon one enemy when you can harpoon many!
The weighted crossbow is a damage-dealing menace and a real threat from a ranged distance.
Many thought that the Doom Crossbow was just a myth, but this time the rumors turned out to be true.
The Slayer Crossbow is the treasured heirloom of many legendary hunters.
This enchanted bow strengthens the bond between the hunter and their animal companion.
This enchanted bow deepens the bond between the hunter and their trusted animal companion.
The bow prefered by the masters of archery across the Overworld, no matter how simple it appears.
The Ancient Bow is still as sprightly as the day it was first strung.
The Longbow, crafted for hunting rather than battle, is still useful in a fight.
Forged from fossilized coral, the Guardian Bow is a remnant from sunken civilizations of lost ages.
The Red Snake radiates an explosive heat, making it a deadly fire risk in the dry, desert lands.
The question of what makes the Power Bow so powerful has puzzled the minds of learned folk for ages.
The arrows that take flight from the Phantom Bow swoop down on your enemies like the bow's nightmarish namesake.
The secrets of the Elite Power Bow's construction have been lost without a trace.
This bow, built for a long-lost champion, feels right in the hands of those who seek justice.
New reloading technology helps this crossbow fire more rapidly than those that came before it.
This crossbow moves faster than wings in flight and strikes down enemies before they see the bolt.
The Arch-Illager said the design for this powerful crossbow came to him in a vision.
This crossbow, modified to hold and fire multiple bolts, is also a half-decent musical instrument.
Half musical instrument and fully deadly weapon, the Harp Crossbow is the life of the party.
Adding electrical energy to this crossbow changed the firing sound dramatically.
Those who wish to use the Shadow Crossbow must train in total darkness before wielding it.
The Veiled Crossbow cloaks the wielder in shadow, perfect for those who prefer to go unnoticed (and undefeated).
The preferred weapon of thieves and rogues, the Shortbow is nimble and lethal at short range.
Named the Purple Storm after its lovely hue, this legendary bow packs a powerful punch.
A brand new development in quick firing technology, this bow packs a swift punch.
Love can be magical, but when it becomes too powerful, it can turn into a frenzy.
Those who face the Snow Bow in battle must also prepare to face the chill of freezing wintry winds.
Crafted from the webs of mighty spiders, the Webbed Bow will get you out of any sticky situation.
Arrows fired from this legendary bow are said to be carried by the winter winds themselves.
The Soul Bow shimmers with all the beauty and fury of an attacking Vex.
The souls bound to the bow guide the arrows to their targets and cause it to glow slightly.
This bow, made of cursed bones, strips the living of their very souls.
The Shivering Bow pierces even the most ancient ice and strikes a chill into the heart of any enemy.
The Soul Crossbow was crafted by the mysterious Evokers and Enchanters of the Woodland Mansions.
If you listen closely you can hear the souls inside the crossbow, usually ridiculing you.
This weapon calls out to souls that are trapped between this world and the next.
A sleek bow that seems to never miss its target.
The arrows fired from the Green Menace always hit their intended target, even in the thickest fog.
It would be a deadly mistake to underestimate the power of the Pink Scoundrel.
This candy-colored bow has a surprisingly bitter bite.
This bow writhes within your grasp as if trying to wrap its tendrils around everything in its path.
The Weeping Vine Bow's toxic vines create a poisonous haze on the battlefield.
When you pluck the string of the Void Bow, an unsettling silence reverberates across the battlefield.
You can feel the Void whispering from deep within this bow, but behind that sound is another voice in the darkness.
A mesmerizing bow that captures the power of the wind to fire mighty Gale Arrows.
This bow calls upon the twisting winds of the hidden valley where it was first strung.
A bow infused with the force of a rolling wind which can flare up in an instant.

armor.description: Hunter's Armor may not be the fanciest gear around, but it will stop a blade.
Archer's Armor, favored by humble warriors, is cheap to make and still stops a blade.
This armor is light, nimble, and smells faintly of sulfur.
Spider Armor, created by master thieves, is inspired by the agile talents of the Spider.
Defensive? Sure. Fabulous? ABSOLUTELY.
Why leave your adoring fans wanting more when you can wow them with this inspirational outfit?
The Battle Robe is worn by the distinguished Illager Evokers of the Arch-Illager's court.
The distinguished Splendid Robe is worn by the hardened Illager warriors who protect the Arch-Illager.
There always seems to be a slight buzz around the Beenest Armor. Or maybe the buzz is coming from within?
The Beehive Armor hums with the focused power of countless bees.
Granted to the champions of the Overworld by the free villagers as a token of their thanks for many years of protection and assistance. The mark of a true hero.
Only given to the highest caliber of heroes, the Hero's Armor is a precious gift from the Villagers.
This sturdy Climbing Gear is perfect for braving the blistering cold of the icy mountain face.
Take on the worst that nature can throw at you in this rugged armor.
Made from the pelts of Mountain Goats, you'll feel like skipping from peak to peak in this Goat Gear.
Cheap armor made in bulk, the Guard's Armor is a common sight in the villages of the Overworld.
Dark Armor, made in the blackest depths of the Fiery Forge, is worn by the Illager royal guard.
The inspiring tales of the Titan's Shroud armor have passed through Pumpkin Pastures for generations.
As you wear the Emerald Gear during your adventures, it calls other emeralds to you as if by chance.
Opulent Armor, originally designed more for show than for combat, thrives in the presence of Emeralds.
Even death itself has to pause and admire the charms of the legendary Gilded Glory armor.
The Teleportation Robes were made by those who devoted their lives to studying the enigmas of the End.
This Enderobe sparks with static as you sashay across the battlefield.
Potent magical runes are weaved into the fabric of these robes, their origins and true powers are shrouded in mystery.
The Ember Robe was created by Illager Evokers to distinguish themselves from the common guard.
Those who don the Verdant Robe soon find that they can commune with more souls than ever before.
Plate armor turns the average soldier into a fortress but comes with reduced mobility.
The Cauldron Armor was created with camouflage in mind, but what it lacks in stealth it makes up for in bubbly charm.
Full Metal Armor is destined for the great defenders of the Overworld.
Those who wear Ghostly Armor may feel their bodies briefly disconnect from the physical world, but are quickly snapped back to reality.
Strange flames follow the shifting form of those who wear the Ghost Kindler armor.
Strange flames follow the shifting form of those who wear the Ghost Kindler armor.
Grim Armor invokes a sense of dread for the one who wears it and to those who face it in battle.
Those who wear the mantle of The Spooky Gourdian become the legendary terror of Pumpkin Pastures!
Wither Armor, crafted with the parts of slain enemies, was made to terrify the wearer's enemies.
Mercenary Armor, favored by those looking to save some coin, lacks flair but gets the job done.
When you wear this cloak, the sounds of screams fill the air. But are the screams yours, or your enemies'?
Donning this armor brings great power, but along with that power comes a hunger that can never be satisfied...
Renegade Armor made a fine payment for mercenaries hired to protect the villages against Illagers.
Some blacksmiths see the design influence of Iron Golems in this property-shifting armor.
Twisted roots form this aberrant armor, its malevolent nature evident.
This decaying armor has an unsettling presence, as if observing you.
You feel a rush of pure adrenaline surge through your body when you wear this Ocelot's pelt.
The legendary black Ocelot was as graceful as it was deadly. When you wear its pelt, you feel like your enemies are left chasing your shadow.
This armor, crafted from the bones of Phantoms, is a terrifying sight on the battlefield.
Frost Bite remembers the icy winds which once flowed beneath the wings of mighty Phantoms.
Wearing this Piglin Armor is almost enough to make one feel at home in the Nether. Almost.
The Golden Piglin Armor combines a piglin's two favorite things: not dying and gold.
Mostly worn by casual adventurers, Reinforced Mail is a common sight throughout the land.
This reliable armor is sturdy enough to be passed down for generations.
This armor, crafted near the shores of a great sea, was inspired by the scales of fish.
A wise armorer made this armor with care.
Shulker Armor rivals even the toughest steel plate.
They say the best defense is a good offense, but good luck breaking through this bulwark.
A suit of armor that was tempered in snowmelt, protecting the wearer from the harsh cold of the tundra.
This legendary armor, forged from ice that never melts, makes the wearer feel as if they are one with winter.
In a particular light, the souls woven into the cloth of the Soul Robe shimmer with power.
The Souldancer Robe comes alive in the light, as if the souls within are dancing for all eternity.
The Spelunker Armor is worn by those who brave the darkest depths of the Overworld.
The Cave Crawler armor has been passed down through generations of brave spelunkers and miners.
This armor may look like a piece of cake to your enemies, but it is surprisingly durable in battle. Must be the fondant.
The dark vines of the Sprout Armor continue to grow even in complete darkness.
This armor is made from the living vines of a plant which grows only on battlefields.
It was easy to make this jet-black armor look cool. The hard part was securing the ink sacs.
Those who hunt elusive glow squids wear this armor to blend in with their beautiful prey.
The Turtle Armor is inspired by the hardy and protective shell of the humble turtle.
This armor is made from the dense (but surprisingly light) shells of turtles who lived at crushing depths.
Many warriors wear the heads of wolves into battle to strike fear into the hearts of their enemies.
Ancient Villager tribes created this armor to honor the fox, who is a great and agile warrior.
The wolf who strikes from the shadows lives to tell the tale.
If you want to survive the icy tundra in style, the Arctic Fox Armor is the best choice this season.

artifact.description: Grants invisibility and boosts your next melee attack.
Bee lovers and the bee-loved alike are fans of the Buzzy Nest, but don't be fooled by the cute bees within - they pack a powerful sting!
Boots blessed with enchantments to allow for swift movements. Useful in uncertain times such as these.
Set your enemies up for the surprise of a lifetime with the explosive power of Scatter Mines.
The Corrupted Beacon holds immense power within. It waits for the moment to unleash its wrath.
The Corrupted Pumpkin glows with supernatural power, illuminating even the darkest nights with its powerful beacon.
A pouch of poisonous corrupted seeds which grow into spiky grapple vines, entangling and slowly draining the life from its victims.
Eaten by daring warriors before battle, the Death Cap Mushroom drives fighters into a frenzy.
Meant only to be wielded by Enchanters, the magic of this artifact can summon powerful enchantments.
The explosive power of the TNT combined with the high velocity movement of an arrow - what could possibly go wrong?
The trusted companion of any true adventurer, the Fishing Rod is useful for more than just fishing.
This quiver is filled with the deadliest of arrows.
The souls trapped within the Ghost Cloak are protective, but they radiate a sense of melancholy.
Iron Golems have always protected the Villagers of the Overworld. Their numbers are dwindling as a result of the Arch-Illager's war.
This ancient gong, marked with the symbols of a nameless kingdom, feels safe in your hands but emits a menacing hum to those nearby.
The Eye of the Guardian holds a power that awakens in the hands of a worthy hero.
The Harvester siphons the souls of the dead, before releasing them into a cluster hex of power.
A potion that restores health.
This quiver holds a number of harpoons that swiftly pierce through enemies on land or underwater.
The Ice Wand was trapped in a tomb of ice for ages, sealed away by those who feared its power.
The Iron Hide Amulet is both ancient and timeless. Sand mysteriously and endlessly slips through the cracks in the iron.
No one knows what mysterious creature this feather came from, but it is as beautiful and powerful.
Crafted by Illager Geomancers, this item is enchanted with the power of a storming sky.
Summons Guardian Vexes who will fight by your side for a short time.
A spell radiates from this trinket, enchanting those nearby into a trance where they must protect the holder of the medallion at all costs.
The Powershaker is a smashing good time, though it may not be as fun for your enemies.
Only the bravest of warriors carry the Blast Fungus. Not just because of its toxic spores, but because it smells awful.
Oakwood Brew
Just as there are powerful heroes who answer the call to fight, there are powerful enchanted sheep who will join the fight when summoned.
The Satchel of Elixirs always contains the exact potions you need! (Well, at least the potions it thinks you need, which is still pretty helpful.)
The Satchel of Snacks provides a treat when you need it most!
Mysteries surround this primordial satchel. Will it unleash fire, ice, or something a lot less nice?
The Shadow Shifter grants you Shadow Form, which allows you to stay out of sight.
Shock Powder is a reliable tool for those who wish to make a swift exit.
The Soul Healer amulet is cold to the touch and trembles with the power of souls.
This lantern, still covered in the sands of some far-flung place, allows those who hold it to summon a creature formed from bound souls.
All who are near this totem feel an invigorating aura around their artifacts.
This whirling weapon spins across the battlefield, slicing through enemies in its path.
Briefly boosts attack damage.
Briefly boosts movement speed.
You hear distant howling as you hold the Tasty Bone in your hand.
This copper quiver channels the power of lightning.
A magical tome which when read is capable of duplicating items such as food, potions and explosives!
The Torment Quiver radiates powerful energy drawn from the eternal source of the Undead.
This hand-crafted wooden figurine radiates a warmth like that of a crackling campfire, healing those who gather around it.
This totem radiates powerful energy that bursts forth as a protective shield around those near it.
An ancient book filled with illegible glyphs, you feel a strange breeze as you flip through the pages.
The Void Quiver is filled with arrows that splash Void Liquid when they hit their target.
Grants the ability to breathe freely underwater for a limited time.
When the Wind Horn echoes throughout the forests of the Overworld the creatures of the night tremble with fear.
This item has the faint smell of an open field, baked bread, and freshly cut crops.

Briefly gain Ghost Form when rolling
Traps and poisons nearby mobs when rolling
Brief damage immunity when collects an emerald
Resists any form of knockback by {0}
Reset Artifact cooldown on Potion use
Release an ink cloud when rolling
Release an ink cloud when rolling
